description: Up to 10 live Shopify stores matching filters (category, country, apps they run or lack, pixels, theme), sorted by popularity, estimated US visits, recent launches or catalog size.

app.description: Comma-separated app keys the store runs (all of them, max 5). Keys by category: Email & SMS marketing: klaviyo, attentive, postscript, omnisend, privy; Pop-ups & conversion: justuno; Product reviews: judge_me, okendo, yotpo, loox, stamped, trustpilot, reviews_io; Customer support: gorgias, tidio; Subscriptions: recharge; Upsell & personalization: rebuy; Price & A/B testing: intelligems; Returns & shipping: loop_returns, aftership, route; Buy now, pay later: afterpay, klarna, affirm, shop_pay_installments; Analytics: hotjar, lucky_orange; Analytics & attribution: triple_whale, elevar; Wishlists: swym_wishlist; Loyalty & rewards: rivo_loyalty, smile_loyalty, yotpo_loyalty; Page builders: shogun, pagefly, gempages, replo, zipify; Translation: langify, weglot; Cross-border commerce: global_e

category.description: Store category key, e.g. fashion, beauty, home, health, food-drink, pets

country.description: Two-letter country code of the store's business address, e.g. US

no_app.description: Comma-separated app keys the store runs none of (max 10), e.g. all of a category's keys for 'no reviews app'

no_pixel.description: Comma-separated pixel keys the store runs none of

pixel.description: Comma-separated pixel keys the store runs: meta, tiktok, google_ads, google_analytics, pinterest, snapchat, microsoft_ads, reddit, northbeam, rakuten

name: find_stores
title: Find Shopify stores
